title: dk-quickstart-index-1.0
description: Schema for a dk0 quickstart registry index. The index lists all available quickstart groups with human-readable descriptions.

schema_version.description: Version of the dk-quickstart-index schema used by this index.

groups.description: List of quickstart groups available in this registry.

name.description: Group name (e.g. 'ocaml'), used as the GROUP argument in 'dk0 quickstart GROUP NAME' and as the group directory in the registry path.

description.description: Short human-readable description of what the group sets up. Third-party text rendered on diskuv.com, so HTML-significant characters ('<', '>', '&'), BIDI overrides, and invisible/control characters are rejected.

registry_url.description: Optional base URL for a group hosted on its own registry. When present, recipes are fetched from <registry_url>/<NAME>.quickstart.jsonc and the group index from <registry_url>/index.jsonc. When absent, the group lives under the base registry at <base>/<name>/.
